approval_ref: The active user goal requests continued adaptability improvements for email content and explicitly prefers open-source reuse under /ponytail.
notes: Outlook MSG is a documented unsupported email format and currently reaches the generic unsupported result.
Reuse the MIT-licensed python-oxmsg parser instead of implementing the OLE MSG format.
Adapt MSG into the existing EML evidence, workflow and selected-attachment paths rather than creating a second semantic parser.
Keep parsing local, bounded to 8 MB, attachment content inert until explicit import, and all validation offline without credentials or model calls.
Three public upstream MSG fixtures and the 599-test full Python suite passed; specification, source-manifest, localization and deployment-boundary checks also passed.
title: Add local Outlook MSG email support
objective: Parse bounded local Outlook MSG files into the existing safe email evidence and workflow model, including explicit selected-attachment import, by reusing a small MIT-licensed parser.
